caption: The drawing depicts a fragmented sculpture of a human figure, shown from the upper thighs to the head in profile facing left. The figure has a stylized, painted face with prominent red and brown accents on the cheeks, chin, and forehead. The hair is painted black and closely cropped. The figure is clothed in what appears to be a flowing garment rendered in shades of beige, tan, and brown, with some areas appearing chipped or eroded. There is a hint of a collar or patterned neckpiece at the neckline colored in darker tones, alongside a reddish-brown section that may represent part of the garment or armor near the neck and shoulder area. The surface of the object shows visible wear and deterioration, with several flaked and missing patches revealing a lighter base underneath. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no other objects or elements in the composition.
title: Figurehead
